options.name: Safety Delay
options.description: Seconds to allow for game-server responses when waiting for prompts or menus. Increase on high-latency connections.

options.name: Default Combat Order
options.description: Default order clients enter combat (e.g. '2, 1' sends client 2 first). Empty = all clients enter simultaneously. Can be overridden per node via Option Overrides.
